prompts.label: Create Angular project with ng new
prompts.text:
I'm a beginner with Angular. Guide me to create a new project from scratch.

- Install Node LTS, npm install -g @angular/cli
- ng new my-app (routing yes, stylesheet CSS or SCSS)
- Explain src/app structure: app.component, main.ts, angular.json
- ng serve and open localhost:4200

Use Angular 17+ CLI commands. List key files created.

prompts.label: Standalone component basics
prompts.text:
Teach standalone components in modern Angular (no NgModule required).

- Generate a HelloComponent with standalone: true
- Import CommonModule or specific directives in imports array
- Bootstrap with bootstrapApplication in main.ts
- Show selector usage in app template

Explain why standalone is the default style now.

prompts.label: Signals for reactive state
prompts.text:
Introduce Angular signals for a beginner counter example.

- signal(0), increment in method, display with {{ count() }}
- Show computed() for doubled value
- Brief effect() mention for side effects
- Contrast with plain class fields in 3 bullets

Provide a minimal standalone component.

prompts.label: @Input and @Output parent-child
prompts.text:
Build parent-child communication with @Input and @Output.

- Child ItemCardComponent receives title via @Input
- Child emits selected via @Output EventEmitter
- Parent handles (selected) and updates list
- Use required inputs if Angular 17+

Show both component files and parent template.

prompts.label: Injectable service and DI
prompts.text:
Create a DataService with dependency injection.

- @Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' }) with getItems() returning mock array
- Inject into AppComponent or a feature component via constructor
- Explain singleton scope and why services beat duplicating logic
- Optional: inject in standalone component

Provide service + consumer example.

prompts.label: HttpClient GET request
prompts.text:
Fetch JSON with HttpClient in a standalone Angular app.

- provideHttpClient() in app.config or imports
- Inject HttpClient, call get<T>() on jsonplaceholder or mock API
- Display results in template with @for
- Mention error handling with catchError briefly

Show component + config wiring.

prompts.label: Route guards CanActivate
prompts.text:
Protect a route with a guard for beginners.

- Define routes with /login and /dashboard
- CanActivateFn (functional guard) checking auth stub service
- Redirect to /login if not authenticated
- Wire routes in app.routes.ts

Explain when guards run in navigation lifecycle.

prompts.label: Reactive forms FormGroup
prompts.text:
Build a login form with ReactiveFormsModule.

- FormBuilder group: email, password with Validators.required and email
- Template binds formGroup and formControlName
- Submit logs value when valid; show field errors
- Import ReactiveFormsModule in standalone component

Prefer reactive over template-driven for this lesson.

prompts.label: RxJS map and switchMap
prompts.text:
Teach RxJS pipe with map and switchMap on HttpClient.

- map to transform response shape
- switchMap for search: Subject or valueChanges debounced to HTTP
- Explain switchMap cancels prior inner subscription
- Contrast mergeMap in one sentence for beginners

Minimal TypeScript example with comments.

prompts.label: HTTP interceptor logging
prompts.text:
Add a functional HTTP interceptor for request/response logging.

- HttpInterceptorFn adding header or logging URL
- Register with provideHttpClient(withInterceptors([...]))
- Show clone request pattern
- Warn not to log sensitive tokens

Dev-only logging mindset; one interceptor file.

prompts.label: Lazy loaded feature routes
prompts.text:
Split app into lazy-loaded feature routes.

- Admin feature route with loadComponent or loadChildren
- Separate admin.routes.ts
- Verify separate chunk in build output conceptually
- Default route and wildcard 404

Explain bundle size benefit for beginners.

prompts.label: OnPush change detection
prompts.text:
Demonstrate OnPush change detection on a presentational component.

- Set changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush
- Pass immutable @Input data from parent
- Explain when change detection runs vs Default
- Mention signals as friendly companion to OnPush

Small list component example.

prompts.label: Angular Material intro
prompts.text:
Add Angular Material to a standalone project.

- ng add @angular/material steps
- Import MatButtonModule and MatToolbar in component
- Simple toolbar + button UI
- Mention theming and accessibility basics

Do not build full app — intro only.

prompts.label: SSR and Angular Universal overview
prompts.text:
Explain Server-Side Rendering for Angular beginners.

- What SSR solves: SEO, first paint
- ng add @angular/ssr high-level steps
- Contrast prerender vs dynamic server
- When CSR-only is fine for internal apps

Conceptual checklist — no full deploy.

prompts.label: Unit test with TestBed
prompts.text:
Write a first component unit test with Jasmine/Karma or Jest.

- TestBed.configureTestingModule with standalone component
- createComponent, detectChanges, query DOM text
- Test @Input binding or button click
- npm test command

One spec file matching a simple component.

prompts.label: i18n localize templates
prompts.text:
Introduce internationalization in Angular templates.

- i18n attribute on h1 and button
- Extract messages workflow mention (ng extract-i18n)
- One second locale example conceptually (fr)
- When ngx-translate differs briefly

Beginner scope — no full build pipeline.

prompts.label: Production build checklist
prompts.text:
Give a beginner checklist before ng build --configuration production.

- environment.ts production flags
- Budgets in angular.json mention
- outputHashing and source maps off for prod
- API URL from environment

List commands; no cloud deploy steps.

prompts.label: Migrate NgModule to standalone checklist
prompts.text:
I have an older NgModule-based Angular app. Outline migration to standalone.

- Run ng update and official standalone migration schematic mention
- Convert one feature module: move declarations to standalone imports
- Replace NgModule bootstrap with bootstrapApplication
- Checklist: RouterModule, providers, third-party libs

Step-by-step learning checklist, not automated rewrite.

prompts.label: ng generate and project layout
prompts.text:
Teach Angular CLI generators for project structure.

- ng generate component user-list --standalone
- ng generate service user --flat
- Explain where files land in src/app
- Naming conventions for selectors and files

List commands and resulting tree for a tiny feature.

prompts.label: Custom pipe PurePipe
prompts.text:
Create a custom pipe for template formatting.

- @Pipe standalone pipe truncating text with max length
- Use in template {{ longText | truncate:50 }}
- Explain pure: true default and performance note
- Contrast pipe vs method in template briefly

One pipe file + usage example.
